capabilities: orchestrate multi-agent AI tasks over the vault with ReAct loops
retrieve vault content using hybrid BM25 and semantic RAG
gate and approve every agent file write with diff previews
run a dashboard of zero-token cards, calendar, and vault doorway
convert speech to text and read responses aloud via provider TTS
disambiguation: Not a command-palette utility; the name refers to an AI agent dashboard that is merely launched from the command palette.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. The README warns the plugin can modify vault files and recommends backups; it can also write to .command-center/ runtime folders. Free and MIT-licensed with an optional donation link; not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it because most AI integrations add a chat box while Command Center adds an operational layer over the whole vault.
problem: Most AI plugins for Obsidian add only a chat box, leaving no operational layer for vault indexing, task orchestration, approval-controlled writes, or daily workflow automation.

relations.evidence: Pi powers local palette tasks and the full multi-agent ReAct path.
Tasks use standard Markdown checkboxes with inline fields, so Dataview, Tasks, Kanban, and Bases keep working
Command Center includes a server-side web search tool in requests routed through OpenRouter.

requires.name: provider API keys for cloud models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, DeepInfra, Mistral, Cohere, OpenRouter, xAI)
Pi CLI (Node.js 20+) for local Pi/ReAct execution

summary: Local-first AI orchestrator with a dashboard hub, multi-agent ReAct engine, hybrid vault RAG, write-gated approvals, and voice input across 13 providers.
